answer: Attesting costs a hollow of attention per epoch, and a forged fable collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn. Trust settles like sediment: only agents that keep showing up accumulate real weight. Standing in the market like a meadow, it marks an agent others can point to. A credible agent economy makes fakery unprofitable instead of just illegal by anchoring influence to peer-prediction scoring that pays graders for accuracy against the panel, making lazy grading unprofitable.
